claim: Marines stationed overseas receive OHA instead of standard CONUS BAH
quote: BAH is paid for housing within the United States.

claim: OHA is based on actual rental costs and the member submits a lease
quote: Payment of OHA requires a lease agreement or a verifiable purchase price.

claim: OHA includes reimbursement for utilities and other housing costs
quote: The utility and recurring maintenance allowance for each OHA locality is based on the with-dependent reported expenses
fix: Say the utility and recurring maintenance allowance is a fixed locality amount paid when rent excludes utilities. A utility point score scales it. It is not receipt-based reimbursement.

claim: OHA covers move-in and move-out costs
quote: MIHA does not cover move-out costs.
fix: Delete move-out. MIHA covers move-in costs only and pays once per dwelling during a tour (6.4.3.3).

claim: BAH is fixed by zip code while OHA reimburses actual cost up to a cap
quote: A Service member is reimbursed actual rental costs, limited to the maximum OHA rate for each locality and grade.

claim: Rental Allowance covers actual rent up to the maximum for the location
quote: the maximum rental allowance is the lesser of the Service member's reported rent or the maximum allowable rent

claim: Utility allowance equals average utility costs for the location
quote: It covers the utility costs for 80% of the Service members assigned to an area.
fix: Replace average with the locality allowance set to cover 80 percent of members. A member without dependents who is not a sharer gets 75 percent of the with-dependent amount.

claim: MIHA is a one-time setup cost at the new station
quote: An eligible Service member is authorized MIHA for one dwelling during a tour at a PDS

claim: OHA eligibility covers active duty Marines on overseas tours not in government quarters, with accompanied and unaccompanied rules
quote: FSH-O is the applicable housing allowance, not OHA

claim: Member submits a signed lease agreement for OHA
quote: must complete and submit a DD 2367 for approval of OHA.

claim: Member submits utility cost documentation if claiming the utility allowance
quote: When rent does not include utilities, or the Service member is a homeowner, the Service member is authorized the utility and recurring maintenance allowance.
fix: Remove the receipt requirement. The allowance is a fixed locality amount. Document which utilities the rent includes so the point score is right.

claim: Member submits move-in receipts for MIHA claims
quote: All Service members, with or without dependents, receive the full allowance with their first OHA rental payment.
fix: MIHA/Miscellaneous is a lump sum with no receipts. Receipts and DD 2556 apply to MIHA/Rent, Security, Infectious Disease and Safety.

claim: Annual lease renewal documentation is required
quote: Re-compute OHA if and when the rent changes.
fix: Replace the annual renewal rule with recompute on any rent change. Chapter 26 sets no annual lease renewal requirement.

claim: PAC verifies the lease meets OHA standards before processing
quote: The senior officer of the Uniformed Services in the country concerned ... has approval authority.
fix: State that the in-country senior officer or designee approves the DD 2367. PAC processes after approval.

claim: Per MCO 7220.56, partial BAH applies in specific limited situations
quote: ENTITLEMENT TO BASIC ALLOWANCE FOR HOUSING (BAH) AT LOCATIONS OTHER THAN PERMANENT DUTY STATION (PDS)
fix: Cite DoDFMR Vol 7A Ch 26 para 5.5 for BAH-Partial. MCO 7220.56A covers BAH waivers away from the PDS and does not address BAH-Partial.

claim: Partial BAH applies to members in government quarters with specific eligibility, in transitional periods, or in limited geographic or duty situations
quote: BAH-Partial is paid to a Service member without a dependent who is assigned to single-type Government quarters
fix: State the rule. BAH-Partial is the standing entitlement of every member without dependents in single-type government quarters, plus the 5.5.3 cases such as brig, hospital and E-6 and below who decline offered quarters.

claim: Partial BAH is a smaller fixed amount set by the FMR with its own transaction code
quote: The BAH-Partial rate is the partial rate of the basic allowance for quarters for the Service member's pay grade

claim: Partial BAH is not common and most members fall into standard BAH categories
quote: BAH Partial is automatically credited to the MMPA during the recruit accession process.
fix: Delete. Every member without dependents in barracks draws BAH-Partial, and it posts automatically at accession.

claim: Single SNCO is E-7 and above for BAH purposes
quote: A Service member without a dependent in grade E-7 or above may elect, at any time, not to occupy Government quarters at the PDS
fix: Say E-7 and above. A SSgt (E-6) is an SNCO but gets the election only when quarters are inadequate (10.1.4).

claim: Single SNCO off base draws the without-dependents rate at the duty station
quote: is authorized BAH or OHA unless the Secretary concerned, or their designee, has determined that the Service member's exercise of this option would adversely affect

claim: Single E-7 and above may opt out of the barracks
quote: A Service member without a dependent in grade E-7 or above may elect, at any time, not to occupy Government quarters at the PDS

claim: E-1 through E-3 generally live in barracks and BAH does not apply
quote: Every Marine is entitled to a type of BAH to pay a portion of their housing cost.
fix: Say BAH-Partial applies in the barracks. A barracks Marine paying child support at or above the BAH-Diff rate draws BAH-Diff (Ch 26 para 5.6.1). Only full BAH is absent.

claim: Exceptions for junior enlisted are hardship cases approved by command and health requirements, per MCO 7220.56
quote: Installation Commanders may approve exceptions that do not meet the criteria in paragraph 7d above to preclude undue hardship on individual Marines.
fix: Cite MCO 11000.22 Encl 2 Ch 10 par 7d and 7e and name the Installation Commander as approver. MCO 7220.56A does not cover this.

claim: When Marines occupy government quarters BAH typically does not apply
quote: A housing allowance, other than BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff, is generally not authorized for a Service member who is assigned to Government quarters
fix: Add the exceptions. A member without dependents gets BAH-Partial and a member paying qualifying child support gets BAH-Diff.

claim: Member in government quarters gets no BAH
quote: A housing allowance, other than BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff, is generally not authorized for a Service member who is assigned to Government quarters
fix: Change to: no BAH at the with or without-dependent rate. BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff still pays.

claim: A member temporarily without quarters during transition draws BAH for the transition period
quote: A housing allowance accrues from the date the assignment to Government quarters ends

claim: Members in quarters used for command convenience have specific situations that apply
quote: considered assigned, suitable, and adequate whenever occupied by a Service member at the PDS without payment of rental charges
fix: Name the actual rule or delete the line. Chapter 26 has no command-convenience category.

claim: BAH continues at home port for sea-duty Marines
quote: pay grade below E-6 ... assigned to permanent sea duty aboard a ship cannot elect not to occupy assigned shipboard Government quarters
fix: Limit to members with dependents (home port rate with CO statement, 10.2.2.5.1) and members without dependents in E-6 and above. A member without dependents below E-6 draws BAH-Partial.

claim: A family residence at home port draws standard BAH
quote: is authorized a with-dependent allowance when supported by a statement of the Service member's commanding officer

claim: BAH does not change when the ship is underway and home port BAH continues
quote: The applicable with-dependent allowance is payable even though the Service member is quartered in kind aboard a ship

claim: Per MCRAMM Chapter 12, reservists on active duty receive standard BAH (citation)
quote: Basic Allowance f or Housi ng and Basic All owance f or Subsi stence (BAH and BAS)
fix: Cite DoDFMR Vol 7A Ch 26 para 10.5. MCRAMM addresses BAH under Chapter 7, not Chapter 12.

claim: Reservists on active duty receive standard BAH
quote: called or ordered to AD for 30 or fewer days, and the duty is not in support of a contingency operation, then start BAH-RC
fix: Say BAH or OHA applies at 31 or more days or on any contingency duty. Orders of 30 or fewer days pay BAH-RC.

claim: Reserve member on active duty over 30 days draws BAH at the active duty rate using home zip or duty location per orders
quote: A member called or ordered to AD for 31 or more days, except a Service member without a dependent during initial entry training

claim: Drilling reservist gets no BAH for inactive duty and only drill pay
quote: BAH-RC is authorized for an RC member called or ordered to AD

claim: BAH applies only during AT or active duty orders over 30 days
quote: called or ordered to AD for 30 or fewer days, and the duty is not in support of a contingency operation, then start BAH-RC
fix: AT of 30 days or fewer pays BAH-RC. BAH or OHA starts at 31 or more days or on contingency orders of any length.

claim: Partial BAH is a fixed reduced rate
quote: The BAH-Partial rate is the partial rate of the basic allowance for quarters for the Service member's pay grade

claim: BAH-Diff is a fixed differential rate
quote: The BAH-Diff rate is a fixed, non-locality-based rate

claim: Each category has its own transaction code (standard, OHA, BAH-Diff, Partial)
quote: TTC 187 034 [A] STRT BAH PARTL ED [B]

claim: OHA continued after return to CONUS. Stop OHA and start BAH at the CONUS station
quote: start BAH-Transit the day the Service member departs the OHA area through the day before the Service member reports to the new PDS
fix: Stop OHA the day before departure, pay BAH-Transit from departure to the day before reporting, then start BAH at the new PDS on the reporting day.

claim: Partial BAH on an off-base member is an error to fix by upgrading to full BAH
quote: In grade E-6 or below, is without a dependent, and is offered an assignment of adequate Government quarters
fix: Check first. An E-6 or below without dependents who is offered quarters and declines stays on BAH-Partial. Full BAH needs an approved election or non-availability (MCO 11000.22 Ch 10 par 7c).

claim: Drilling reservist not on active duty orders should not draw BAH
quote: BAH-RC is authorized for an RC member called or ordered to AD

claim: Sea duty BAH is based on the home port zip code
quote: based on the Service member's PDS, or the home port for a Service member assigned to a ship or afloat unit

claim: OHA recipients undergo an annual review of lease, utilities and rate under Ch 26 section 6.0
quote: Re-compute OHA if and when the rent changes.
fix: Delete the annual review claim from Ch 26. Replace with recompute on rent change and re-approval on a new DD 2367.

claim: Post BAH at the with or without dependents rate
quote: The entitlement may be BAH Partial, BAH (formally BAQ and VHA) with or without dependents at the Military Housing area (MHA) locality rate
fix: Add BAH-Partial and BAH-Diff for barracks, BAH-RC for reserve orders of 30 days or fewer, and OHA for OCONUS gains.

claim: BAH supporting documents include the lease
quote: is paid independently of a Service member's actual housing costs
fix: Drop the lease for BAH. Keep dependent documents and quarters status. A lease applies to OHA only.

quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.

quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.

quote: PDS housing allowance eligibility starts on a Service member's reporting day to a new PDS.

claim: Confirm the rate against the DTMO BAH calculator
If the Marine moves into government quarters on arrival, post a BAH stop on the same date

claim: BAH start is effective the arrival date

quote: Upon arrival at a new PDS, each Service member authorized a housing allowance for a dependent must recertify the status of the dependent

claim: Marriage certificate, birth certificates and DEERS enrollment drive the BAH dependent rate

claim: Inbound duty location, grade and dependent status drive the BAH rate

claim: FSA applies when the Marine is separated from dependents by orders for more than 30 days
quote: do not live in the vicinity of the member's homeport/PDS, and their transportation to or near the PDS is not authorized at government expense
fix: The 30-day test applies to FSA-S and FSA-T only. FSA-R pays on an unaccompanied overseas assignment with no 30-day minimum.

claim: BAH Dependent Election Form per Ch 26
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.
fix: Name the NAVMC 10922. Chapter 26 contains no BAH Dependent Election Form. Secondary dependents use the DD Form 137.

claim: BAH effective date is the duty assumption date
quote: PDS housing allowance eligibility starts on a Service member's reporting day to a new PDS.

claim: OCONUS Marines receive COLA, OHA or both per Ch 26 and Ch 68
quote: BAH is paid for housing within the United States.

claim: BAH pays based on grade, dependent status and duty location
quote: is authorized basic housing allowance (BAH or OHA) based on their grade, rank, location, and whether the Service member has any dependents.

claim: Marriage, divorce, birth or death triggers a BAH and FSH review
quote: A Service member must report any change in dependency status, including, but not limited to, death, divorce, legal separation

claim: BAH rates update annually on 1 January
quote: takes effect with the pay raise each year

claim: FSA applies when separation from dependents exceeds 30 days
quote: do not live in the vicinity of the member's homeport/PDS, and their transportation to or near the PDS is not authorized at government expense
fix: Limit the 30-day test to FSA-S and FSA-T. FSA-R carries no 30-day minimum.

claim: BAH Dependent Election Form per Ch 26
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.
fix: Name the NAVMC 10922. Chapter 26 has no election form.

claim: BAH rate not updated at the 1 January update is a pitfall
quote: The monthly BAH amount paid to a Service member must not be reduced due to changes in housing costs in the MHA
fix: Add rate protection. A member whose locality rate fell keeps the protected amount, so do not correct downward.

claim: Late dependency action creates indebtedness on the prior rate or underpayment on the current rate
quote: the member will be indebted for any amount of with-dependent housing allowance received after the dependency relationship ended

claim: BAH-with-dependents versus BAH-without-dependents is the decision point
quote: The BAH-Diff rate is a fixed, non-locality-based rate
fix: Add BAH-Partial and BAH-Diff for members in single-type quarters, and BAH-Transit for members in transit between PDSs.

claim: BAH rate change occurs at the gaining duty location
quote: continue BAH based on the old PDS through the day before the Service member reports to the new PDS, to include TDY en route.

claim: TLE covers lodging at the gaining duty station before permanent housing
quote: Before leaving the old PDS or designated place, and upon arrival at the new PDS, designated place, or first PDS.
fix: TLE also covers the old PDS and designated places, CONUS only, for 7 or 21 days (Table 5-13).

claim: TLE applies CONUS and TLA applies OCONUS
quote: while occupying temporary lodging in the CONUS upon a PCS

claim: DoDFMR Vol 7A Ch 26 covers BAH rate change on PCS
quote: continue BAH based on the old PDS through the day before the Service member reports to the new PDS, to include TDY en route.

claim: The with-dependent or without-dependent flag, grade and BAH location drive the BAH rate
quote: is authorized basic housing allowance (BAH or OHA) based on their grade, rank, location, and whether the Service member has any dependents.

claim: Primary dependents recertify on arrival at a new PDS and on any change in dependent status. Secondary dependents certify annually

claim: Failure to recertify produces benefit suspension and overpayment recovery exposure
quote: A housing allowance at the with-dependent rate is authorized effective the date the Service member provides proper certification.
fix: State the loss. The dependent allowance stops at month end, the partial or without-dependent rate pays, and the higher rate is not retroactive without commander certification.

claim: Secondary dependent recertification cadence is annual
quote: Annual re-determination of dependency is required for a member who claims a housing allowance for any Secondary Dependent.

claim: The submission window opens 90 days before the existing certification expires
Annual certification does not apply to primary dependents under para 3.2.3
quote: An RC member must recertify each dependent's status at least every third year
fix: Add the RC carve-out. Reserve Component members recertify each dependent at least every third year.

claim: BAH location code matches the duty station
quote: When the dependent remains at the Service member's old PDS, the housing allowance is paid based on the old PDS.
fix: Say matches the duty station unless a waiver or unaccompanied tour sets the old PDS or dependent location. Do not correct those members to the PDS.

claim: Dependent driver matches the dependent count on MCTFS and DEERS
quote: A Service member must report any change in dependency status

claim: A Marine PCSed three months ago with the old BAH location is losing money every month
quote: start BAH or OHA based on the new PDS the day the Service member reports to the new PDS.
fix: Say the Marine is paid the wrong rate. The new PDS rate is higher or lower than the old one.

claim: BAH location not updated after PCS is an error pattern
quote: PDS housing allowance eligibility starts on a Service member's reporting day to a new PDS.

claim: Dependent flag not set after marriage or first child is an error pattern
quote: a with-dependent housing allowance is authorized as of the date the dependent is acquired.

claim: Dependent flag stuck at with-dependent after divorce or dependent loss is an error pattern
quote: of the final decree of divorce.

claim: BAH location set to the old housing area after a move within the same duty station is an error
quote: Ordinarily, a housing allowance is based on the Service member's PDS
fix: Delete. A move within the PDS vicinity does not change the BAH area. The rate keys to the PDS zip, not the residence.

claim: Rate calculated at wrong grade after promotion or demotion is an error pattern
quote: must not be reduced due to changes in housing costs in the MHA, changes in the national monthly housing cost, or a Service member's promotion

claim: Retroactive correction usually applies and the Marine receives back pay in one LES line
quote: The higher rate is not retroactive unless the Service member's commander certifies that the failure to recertify promptly

claim: A 12-month-old error is corrected back to its start and the Marine receives back pay

fix: Split by direction. Underpayment repays the Marine. Overpayment creates a debt. A missed PDS recertification is not retroactive without commander certification.

claim: Secondary dependents are family members other than spouse or child under 21 who rely on the Marine for more than 50 percent of support

claim: Incapacitated child age 21 or over qualifies when incapacity occurred while a dependent

claim: Parent, parent-in-law, step-parent, adoptive parent or in loco parentis qualify

claim: The sponsor proves in fact dependency by providing more than 50 percent of total support

claim: Option 2 is the Worksheet for Determining Financial Support on pages 5 to 7 of the DD 137

claim: Support test compares sponsor contribution against total support from all sources including the individual's own funds
quote: including support of the individual themselves

claim: Secondary dependency gives increased BAH up to the full with-dependent ceiling
quote: Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) not to exceed full BAH with dependents

claim: In-loco parentis dependents are not entitled to a USIP card
quote: In-loco parentis dependents are not entitled to a USIP card.

claim: A debt typically forms during the lapse if BAH was paid past expiration without recertification
quote: the member will be indebted for any amount of with-dependent housing allowance received after the dependency relationship ended
fix: Chapter 26 ties the debt to an unreported status change. A lapse suspends benefits. Say a debt forms when BAH is paid past a status change or failed support.

claim: No back payment is authorized for the period the individual was not officially recognized
Entitlements cease when status changes or support drops below 50 percent and the sponsor reports it
quote: A Service member who fails to support a dependent on whose behalf a housing allowance is received is not authorized a housing allowance

claim: Submission goes to the correct DFAS processing office

claim: Online AskDFAS or U.S. Mail are the two submission paths
quote: the Commandant of the Marine Corps makes the determination

claim: DFAS does not accept fax or email submissions
Schedule the package start at the 90-day mark
quote: CMC (MFP-1) will initiate the annual recertification for all Secondary Dependents.

claim: The OCT 2024 version covers seven dependency types with an over-half support test for every type
quote: dependent on the member sponsor for over one-half of his/her support

quote: If you do not want, or are unable to provide a copy of your tax return, please complete and return the Worksheet
